head_commit.message:
Honor the user input setting for asynchronous questions (#51908)

## Why

Disabling `experimental_request_user_input_enabled` previously left `request_user_input_async` available when the model advertised support for it.

## What changed

Require the user input setting to be enabled before registering `request_user_input_async`, while preserving the root-agent restriction and support for both current and legacy model capability names.

## Testing

Add parameterized tests covering enabled and disabled settings, current and legacy capability names, missing capabilities, and subagents. Also verify that `send_message_to_user_async` remains available to root agents independently of the user input setting.

head_commit.message:
Use a dedicated matcher for network domain policies (#51897)

## Why

Network domain rules need explicit wildcard semantics independent of filesystem glob syntax, including matching Unicode hosts with `?`.

## What changed

Replace `globset` in network allowlist and denylist matching with a domain matcher. Make `?` consume one Unicode scalar value, retain ASCII case-insensitive matching and existing host normalization, and preserve the distinction between `*.example.com` and `**.example.com`.

Reject empty patterns, repeated wildcards outside the supported `**.` prefix, character classes, brace expansions, escapes, slashes, and embedded whitespace when loading policies. Continue allowing global wildcards only in allowlists.

## Testing

Add coverage for Unicode wildcard semantics, unsupported syntax, IPv6 normalization, invalid entries in either policy list, and adversarial matching inputs. Compare the matcher against an independent dynamic-programming implementation over exhaustive short inputs.

GitOrigin-RevId: 64f65fcda1a50998d70e046445d22cd2d2dcf27a

head_commit.message:
Preserve native errors in Windows sandbox ACL diagnostics (#51896)

## Why

Windows sandbox setup diagnostics previously displayed only the outer error context, hiding native failure causes needed to diagnose ACL failures.

## What changed

Preserve full error chains in ACL refresh summaries, setup logs, and sandbox binary directory lock failure reports. Include the requested access rights in ACL update open errors, and retain recorded ACL failures even when writing their log entries fails.

## Testing

Add tests covering error chains for ACL checks, grants, and denies; preservation of accumulated failures when logging fails; and native directory-open errors surviving a structured setup report round trip on Windows.
